name: recovery-contact-cooldown
title: Recovery Contact Cooldown
description: Stops account takeovers that start by swapping the recovery email or phone by making the security hold visible: it says what the contact is changing to (masked), drains a countdown to when it takes effect, notes that codes still go to the old contact meanwhile, turns urgent in the last hour, and offers a one-tap cancel plus a "this wasn't me" path, announcing only the outcome, never the ticking.

meta.stops: Account hijacked via swapped recovery email
